Feed.author: Nancy A. Afton
Feed.content: I'm so honored to have been selected for technical training at Sheppard AFB in Texas! I've been studying hard for the Air Force mission, and receiving this special instruction in human relations has been eye-opening.

Feed.author: Arden D. Afton
Feed.content: So incredibly proud of our daughter Nancy. She's worked so hard since graduating from Coopersville and attending Grand Valley. Watching her succeed in the Air Force is the highlight of my year.

Feed.author: Robert A. Smith
Feed.content: Reporting for duty! I've officially joined the 3d Marine Division here in Okinawa. It's a long way from Cedar Springs, but I'm ready for the challenge.

Feed.author: Sherly M. Cole
Feed.content: My son Robert just checked in from Okinawa. It's hard having him so far away, but knowing he's doing his part for the Marines makes it easier. Stay safe, son!

Feed.author: John Mason
Feed.content: The Sand Lake boys are training harder than ever! We're down at the old Hardware building on Main St. every night getting ready for the West Michigan Golden Gloves. These kids have real heart.

Feed.author: Jack Crown
Feed.content: I'm offering free instruction to all boxers from the Ravenna area who want to compete in the Golden Gloves this year. If you've got the drive, I've got the time. Let's get these kids into the ring!

Feed.author: Vern Buffin
Feed.content: She's finally here! Brenda Sue Buffin was born at 12:55 a.m. today at St. Mary's Hospital. 7 lbs. 10 ozs. and absolutely perfect. Mom is doing great!

Feed.author: Albert Hanna
Feed.content: I'm a grandfather again! Little Brenda Sue arrived this morning. I can't wait to head over to the Buffin house and meet her. Her big brother is already excited to show her his toys.

Feed.author: CB Radio Enthusiast
Feed.content: Before you get to a-modulating from your home base, make sure you've got your ears tuned in! A faulty antenna installation can cause serious injury or even death. Safety first, CB'ers!
